role: The Nether and End populate drivers: ChunkProviderHell.populate's fortress stage (its own HashMap-ordered fortress structure map) and eight feature stages from hellRNG, the fortress spawn-list test getPossibleCreatures uses, and BiomeEndDecorator.func_150513_a's ores, obsidian spike and dragon-yaw report.

structs.name: struct end_dragon_spawn
structs.java: BiomeEndDecorator's EntityDragon spawn at chunk 0,0 (whether it spawned and its rotationYaw draw)

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 115, function populate_hell_offer_chunk: realloc growth of the fortress start array on chunk generation
lines 180 and 219, functions populate_hell_fortress_at and populate_hell_structures: realloc of the populate order scratch
lines 183 and 222: container-order dependence carried as java.util.HashMap iteration order via jhm64_order
line 52 and 477, functions hell_feature and populate_end_spike: feature rows looked up by name string (features_nether_for)
line 406, function end_top_solid_or_liquid: world_load_chunk may generate a chunk from inside populate
notes: The fortress stage now runs natively through sc_generate (line 248); the header comment saying the test replays the oracle's recorded fortress writes predates that and is stale. Callers: serverreplay.c, seedworld.c and spawning.c (populate_hell_fortress_at for the blaze/skeleton/pigman fortress list). The End dragon itself is not constructed here; only its yaw draw is reported in end_dragon_last (the dragon entity lives in dragon.c). Java member names for MapGenNetherBridge were not re-opened.
